notes: Option B status snapshots were taken with the first status_b.py: it missed the decision deadline while a flow waits in recv (the recv row is written when the wait ends) and ignored timers inside the child merge_section workflow. Fixed afterwards and verified on fast-mode runs; the stored snapshots are unchanged.
Timings are scaled as listed in the report: idle limit 15 s, tick 1 s, lease TTL 30 s, backoff 5/10/30 s; decision expiry 180 s and episodes 60-120 s as specified.
Host load average was 12-24 on 12 cores during the runs (other agents), so absolute recovery times are inflated; both options ran under the same load.
